logic-lagoon-help-v2: Tap a square, then a picture or number. Every row and column needs one of each. Boxes and cage totals add clues. Notes keep possible numbers. Undo takes back an edit. A hint teaches one step. In Challenge, fill the whole grid and press Check when you are ready. If Level 3 feels easy, Level 4 is open. Level 5 adds sum cages, with no prefilled squares. One-square cages tell you their value.
